definitions.explanation: leave from work to care for a child, typically in the first year after birth

examples.japanese: {育休|いくきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧です。
examples.english: I plan to take childcare leave.

examples.english: More men are taking childcare leave.

examples.english: I just returned from childcare leave.

notes:
ABBREVIATED FORM:
{育休|いくきゅう} is an abbreviation of ⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧ (childcare leave).

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Legally available to both mothers and fathers
- Typically up to 1 year (can be extended to 2 years in some cases)
- Employees receive partial pay through employment insurance
- Government is promoting increased uptake by fathers

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {育休|いくきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ - to take childcare leave
- {育休|いくきゅう}⟦{取得|しゅとく}→取得：11947_shutoku⟧ - taking childcare leave
- {育休|いくきゅう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{復帰|ふっき}する→復帰する：25395_fukkisuru⟧ - to return from childcare leave
- {育休|いくきゅう}{明|あ}け - after returning from childcare leave

GENDER CONTEXT:
⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧{育休|いくきゅう} (paternity leave) is increasingly encouraged in Japan but uptake rates remain low compared to other countries.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{育児休業|いくじきゅうぎょう}→育児休業：25440_ikujikyuugyou⟧ - childcare leave (full term)
- ⟦{介護休暇|かいごきゅうか}→介護休暇：08566_kaigokyuuka⟧ - nursing care leave
- ⟦{時短|じたん}{勤務|きんむ}→時短勤務：18090_jitankinmu⟧ - reduced work hours
